built_from: mock agent + PyNEC solves + one openEMS field dump per band

artifacts.name: placement_map_wifi24.png
artifacts.title: Placement map — WiFi 2.4
artifacts.caption: Where a WiFi 2.4 antenna may legally sit in this device. Sized for its own quarter wave (31 mm) and its own near field, so a different band maps the same phone differently.

artifacts.name: s11_wifi24.png
artifacts.title: Frequency response — WiFi 2.4
artifacts.caption: Reflection against the target band and the spec line the design has to stay under.

artifacts.name: placement_iso_wifi24.png
artifacts.title: Antenna in the device — WiFi 2.4
artifacts.caption: The chosen antenna inside the actual mesh, with the parts that constrain it coloured by material family.

artifacts.name: field_wifi24.mp4
artifacts.title: Radiated field — WiFi 2.4
artifacts.caption: |E| leaving the antenna and crossing the device — the conductors it has to get past are the ones on the map.

artifacts.name: dashboard_wifi24.mp4
artifacts.title: Instrumented run — WiFi 2.4
artifacts.caption: The field, the response and the spec line together, so the wave and the number it produces move in step.

artifacts.name: orbit_wifi24.mp4
artifacts.title: The placement in the round — WiFi 2.4
artifacts.caption: The chosen antenna orbited inside the device, which is how a mechanical engineer will ask to see it.
